summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Emily Warfield, an American actress born August 10, 1972. It records her acting debut in the 1989 TV movie "Dream Date" and her co-starring role in the 1991 film "The Man in the Moon" alongside Reese Witherspoon, who was then unknown.
one_line: Emily Warfield is an American actress born in 1972, known for her 1989 TV movie debut and a 1991 film with Reese Witherspoon.
key_facts: Emily Warfield was born on August 10, 1972.
Emily Warfield is an American actress.
Emily Warfield made her acting debut with the TV movie "Dream Date" in 1989.
Emily Warfield co-starred in the movie "The Man in the Moon" in 1991.
Reese Witherspoon co-starred with Emily Warfield in "The Man in the Moon".
Reese Witherspoon was described as then-unknown at the time of "The Man in the Moon" in 1991.
